context: UI and feedback continuation; PR133 static routing and final reader-count CORS regression

reproducedFailures: Reload of document still retries old request
diagnosis.conclusion: In the isolated WebKit runner, navigation cancellation is incorrectly classified as a host failure. Backup retry starts before pagehide and causes a pageerror. A pagehide-only guard is too late. This evidence does not diagnose a production server CORS outage.

behavior: Retain exact /api or /api/ path restriction for fallback
Observe beforeunload and pagehide only while a retry-capable API request is pending
Never prevent navigation or show a confirmation prompt
Do not retry explicit signal cancellations or native AbortError unless caused by the wrapper's own per-host timeout
Preserve normal network-failure failover and HTTP-response passthrough
fix.concurrentWrite: A targeted src/user-shell.ts write received HTTP409. Latest branch was reread and already contained the equivalent fix at 15198e4. That change was retained without overwrite. This session added deterministic regressions and request lifecycle evidence and independently inspected the results.

coverage: Real document reload with held request
